lines.t: (Intro)
I was searching in the dark, tryna find my way,
Every road I walked just led me to the same place,
Empty hands, a restless heart,
Till You called my name and pulled me out the gray.
(Pre-Chorus)
Now I see it clear, You were always there,
Through every doubt, through every prayer…
(Chorus)
I can't stop loving You,
I can't turn my eyes away,
I wanna feel what is true,
And the truth is You.
This is love, this is love,
Oh, this is love, this is love,
True love, real love, Your heart, my heart,
YahuShua, I can't stop loving You.
And the truth is You.
This is love, this is love,
Oh, this is love, this is love,
True love, real love, Your heart, my heart,
YahuShua, I can't stop loving You.
(Verse 2)
Every heartbeat echoes what You’ve done for me,
Grace like waves keeps crashing endlessly,
I was lost but now I’m found,
And Your mercy is the song I sing.
(Pre-Chorus)
You broke every chain, took away my shame,
And I’ll never be the same…
(Chorus)
I can't stop loving You,
I can't turn my eyes away,
I wanna feel what is true,
And the truth is You.
This is love, this is love,
Oh, this is love, this is love,
True love, real love, Your heart, my heart,
YahuShua, I can't stop loving You.
(Bridge)
Higher than the stars above,
Deeper than the ocean.
You’re the reason that I breathe,
You’re everything to me.
I’ll sing it loud, I’ll sing it true,
There’s nothing greater than You…
(Final Chorus – bigger / repeatable)
I can't stop loving You,
I can't turn my eyes away,
I wanna feel what is true,
And the truth is You.
This is love, this is love,
Oh, this is love, this is love,
True love, real love, Your heart, my heart,
YahuShua, I can't stop loving You.
